radio.title: What makes a friend?
radio.text: Researchers who study friendship say that it takes many hours together to turn a stranger into a close friend. Most people make friends at school, at work or through shared hobbies. Online friendships are becoming more common, but many people still prefer meeting face to face. Interestingly, the number of close friends most adults have is small, usually between three and five.
